market_notes: German-speaking travellers plan thoroughly and search for legality before booking: whether their Internationaler Führerschein covers motorbikes, whether Auslandskranken- and Haftpflichtversicherung pay after a Rollerunfall, and what a Kaution involves. 'Roller' dominates everyday vocabulary; 'Motorrad' appears in licence and touring queries.

proposals.working_title: Internationaler Führerschein für Motorräder in Vietnam

proposals.working_title: Schaden und Diebstahl: Haftungsklauseln im Mietvertrag
proposals.intent_rationale: Disputes over scratches, damage and theft are a major source of rental conflict; explains clauses to read and evidence to keep, without legal promises.
proposals.research_gap: Civil-law liability sources are not attached; drafting must cite the governing civil-code provisions or stay at questions-to-ask level.

proposals.working_title: Zahlt die Reiseversicherung bei einem Rollerunfall in Vietnam?
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders want to know what compulsory liability insurance covers and whether travel insurance pays after a crash; needs current decree references (67/2023 as amended by 220/2026) and policy-specific caveats. German searchers pair Auslandskrankenversicherung with licence class, so insurance and licence validity must be explained together.

proposals.working_title: Welche Spur für den Roller? Spurregeln in Vietnam

proposals.content_angle: Explains Article 13 of Law 36/2024/QH15: slower vehicles keep right, one lane at a time with a signal on marked roads, lanes reserved for certain vehicles, and the Decree 168/2024 fine for improper lane changes, with practical advice for Hanoi ring roads and bridges.
